_ghiChu: Bản tiếng Anh: chỉ chứa chữ, cùng cấu trúc với content.json và được ghép đè lên khi chọn EN. Mảng ghép theo vị trí. null (hoặc bỏ trống khóa) = dùng lại chữ tiếng Việt. Đường dẫn ảnh, số km, ngày giờ... lấy từ content.json.

meta.description: A little card for a 24th birthday.

scene1.lockedSay: So curious! The gift only opens at exactly 00:00 on 01/12.
scene1.giftHint: Tap 3 times to open the gift
lines: Today's Héo's day? Oh, I know!
scene1.phuPeek: Psst… it's Phú Bùi. Someone turns 24 today.

scene2.title: Sagittarius File
scene2.hint: Tap the glowing stars in order
scene2.say: Connect the stars for Héo. What sign is it?
scene2.done: Sagittarius! The sign of people who can't sit still.
scene2.reveal: See? These 8 “teapot” stars are actually the archer's bow and arrow, aimed straight at Antares!

card.label: Top secret file · Level 24
card.note: Warning: invite her out and she's already at the door. No reason needed.

scene3.title: The 2026 Run
scene3.say: Run with Héo! Tap to speed up!

milestones.label: Start 01.12.2002
milestones.text: May everything go smoothly wherever you go, Héo. When it gets too hard, “cry and keep going”, but never give up!

milestones.label: Water station
milestones.text: A refill for Héo, so you always have energy: overflowing, endless, ridiculous amounts of it for the road ahead!

milestones.label: Halfway
milestones.text: May Héo's salary shoot up like a heart rate on an uphill run.

milestones.label: The Wall
milestones.text: No obstacle can stop us Sagittarius folks. Anything blocking your way at 24 gets charged straight through. 24 and strong enough to snap a buffalo's horn!

milestones.label: Finish 01.12.2026
milestones.text: May Héooo get a gorgeous finish-line photo every single year, totally slayyyyyy~

scene3.finish: Finished at 24! May Héoooo get a gorgeous finish-line photo every single year, totally slayyyyyy~

realPhoto.caption: The real deal: Gold Coast Marathon, still posing at the finish
realPhoto.alt: Hiếu finishing the Gold Coast Marathon with a peace sign

scene4.title: Conquering Peak 24
scene4.hint: Swipe up or tap to keep climbing
scene4.say: Climbing? Héo isn't scared of anyone!

flags.title: Flag 1 · Health
flags.text: May Héo have endless energy to conquer one mountain after another~

flags.title: Flag 2 · Money
flags.text: May Héo have plenty of money for race bibs and climbing trips!

flags.title: Flag 3 · Adventure
flags.text: May your passport fill up with stamps, every sky be clear, and every photo look great with zero editing. Pretty without the beauty app :3

flags.title: Flag 4 · Teammate
flags.text: May Héo soon find a better half to adventure with: racing bibs, climbing mountains, and more!

scene4.summit: Peak 24! From up here, every deadline looks tiny.

realPhoto.caption: The real deal: the fog hid the view, but not Héo's swag

scene6.title: To Kim Hiếu
lines: This year, may you stay strong enough to climb every mountain still on your list, run every race you've been saving, and catch so many moments that still make you smile years from now.
May you finish your course soon with awesome results, so you can come back to Vietnam and go wild with Phú Bùi: bánh tráng trộn and a whole hugeee list of food spots we haven't hit yet!!!
And if you can, fly home and celebrate our birthday together for once :))))) hehe

scene7.phuSay: It's Phú Bùi, who else! Today's Phú Bùi's birthday too ^^
scene7.phuSay2: So this last page belongs to both of us. Let's blow out the candles together!
